scope: No solver calls, fitting, training or held-out parameter selection. Descriptive source and training-run audit only.
historical_selection: M3 intersection of training runs in both frozen benchmarks; M4B development-train runs only; no M5 demos

steady_flow.interpretation: Prospective diagnostic screening thresholds, not externally calibrated physics. Sensitivity must be reported in a future larger-fill study. Zero-flow/arch windows are excluded, never free-flow regression points.

benchmarks.definition: Sustained downward passage rate against outlet width D divided by explicitly named particle diameter d
benchmarks.geometry: Same dimensionality, outlet boundary, wall inclination/convention, side/front/back walls, particle mixture and filling/replenishment protocol
benchmarks.source_required: Independent sustained-flow windows, D, particle diameters/masses, passage definition, g and bulk areal density if mass-normalized
benchmarks.simulation_required: Actual crossing times and masses, retained counts, config, numerical diagnostics
benchmarks.aggregation: One rate per eligible independent run; aggregate by identical physical configuration; no pooling zero-flow clogs with rates
benchmarks.uncertainty: Independent-run bootstrap plus geometry, mass, timestamp and bulk-density uncertainty; no frame bootstrap
benchmarks.invalid_if: Unknown units/boundary, mixture diameter undefined, mismatched 2D/3D density, short depleted fill, no sustained flow or fit using clogged zeros

benchmarks.definition: Cumulative observed outlet passages and counts/mass in fixed (a,b] physical-time bins
benchmarks.geometry: Common observation plane and startup reference; impact/load-cell force is not automatically discharged mass
benchmarks.source_required: Calibrated time and mass or reconciled particle crossing events, initial fill, gate/vibration time and sensor transfer function
benchmarks.simulation_required: Cumulative first-crossing count and per-particle crossing times; distinguish first passage from recirculating repeat passages
benchmarks.aggregation: Align physical release times, display individual repeats and group summaries; preserve censored intervals
benchmarks.uncertainty: Clock/frame quantization and mass calibration, clustered by independent fill/experimental session
benchmarks.invalid_if: Divide mean avalanche mass by mean duration and call it sustained rate; compare semicircle versus outlet-plane without reconciliation; infer mass from dynamic support force without load-cell model

benchmarks.definition: Signed vertical/horizontal velocity in specified outlet-relative spatial bins and time window
benchmarks.geometry: Same spatial ROI and origin/sign, common relative heights, averaging and surface/volume/center selection
benchmarks.source_required: Particle positions/velocities with units or calibrated PIV fields, frame rates, optical calibration and tracking uncertainty
benchmarks.simulation_required: Active particle centers/velocities, explicit center-assigned bin selection and number of independent runs
benchmarks.aggregation: Particle-time mean within each bin per run; report counts/missing bins, then equal-run averaging
benchmarks.uncertainty: Tracking/PIV bias, finite spatial bins, run-level bootstrap; correlated frames do not increase independent event count
benchmarks.invalid_if: Unverified Numbers units, fragmented strings, unknown PIV scale, or mixing surface velocity with disk center velocity as an exact match

benchmarks.definition: Explicitly defined occupied area or line fraction in a matched ROI; center-assigned occupancy is a separate estimator
benchmarks.geometry: Identical ROI and clipping/projection convention; 2D disk area is not 3D volume solid fraction
benchmarks.source_required: Calibrated disk geometry and exact occupancy algorithm or documented profile/map fraction
benchmarks.simulation_required: Positions/radii and matched clipped-area or exit-line estimator; M3 center-assigned estimator alone cannot validate another definition
benchmarks.aggregation: Time-weighted fraction per run; independent run means and missing-ROI flags
benchmarks.uncertainty: Segmentation, boundary clipping, overlapping projections and independent repeat variation
benchmarks.invalid_if: Unknown phi meaning; compare 3D solid fraction, projected gravel coverage and center-assigned disk occupancy directly

benchmarks.definition: Separate startup blockage, post-discharge arch and preceding established-flow arch under unchanged operational-observation-v1
benchmarks.geometry: Matched startup preparation, observed boundary, retained material and finite persistence definition
benchmarks.source_required: Unselected complete startup-to-outcome histories, retained-grain evidence, arch geometry, motion and observation duration
benchmarks.simulation_required: Existing M3 first-persistent-arch-v1 labels plus separate M5 descriptive annotations; no relabeling
benchmarks.aggregation: Independent event counts by configuration/type with binomial uncertainty only when run independence and sampling denominator are justified
benchmarks.uncertainty: Onset versus confirmation, tracking-based contact ambiguity, temporal quantization and right censoring
benchmarks.invalid_if: Treat one crossing as established flow; merge 5s experimental exit-stop with 0.4s DEM common-contact label; call external Emptied an empty hopper

benchmarks.definition: Changes in independently aggregated rate/velocity at fixed geometry/fill except the named inclination or friction factor
benchmarks.geometry: Maintain actual angle when varying D; verify external angle reference before conversion; isolate sidewall and front/back friction
benchmarks.source_required: Characterized wall/particle material pairs, angle convention, repeat data and controlled comparisons
benchmarks.simulation_required: Config-verified geometry and same initial conditions for numerical pairs; independent seeds for physical repeats
benchmarks.aggregation: Within-configuration independent-run summaries; report confounding factors, never infer causal friction from unmatched curves
benchmarks.uncertainty: Friction/material uncertainty, angle machining tolerances and between-fill variance
benchmarks.invalid_if: Unknown friction or angle reference; outlet variation unintentionally changes angle; 3D roughness modeled only by a tuned 2D friction

benchmarks.definition: Observed crossing pause followed by observed resumption with retained grains; finite arch confirmation is a separate outcome
benchmarks.geometry: Same observation boundary, sampling resolution and uninterrupted operating window
benchmarks.source_required: Full unscreened passage/motion histories including temporary static states, resumption and retained material
benchmarks.simulation_required: Causal M5 pause/resumption history; complete hopper emptying handled separately
benchmarks.aggregation: Gap distributions by independent run/configuration; preserve truncated/censored gaps
benchmarks.uncertainty: Sampling interval bounds, missed crossings, external forcing and between-run variation
benchmarks.invalid_if: Use no-crossing alone as a clog; remove metastable pauses as a preprocessing step; compare a selected final-clog dataset with unselected operation

calibration_plan.status: Prepared only; no fitting authorized or performed
calibration_plan.potential_source: Dryad circular-grain experiments, conditional on recoverable raw data and verified geometry/units; not currently matched
independent_characterization: particle diameters/species fractions and physical thickness/density
single-collision restitution for the actual approach-only dashpot convention
calibration_plan.bounds_note: Broad screening/assay ranges, not measured material priors. Reject an unmeasured adjustable front/back correction. Choose stiffness numerically rather than fitting a soft overlap to match discharge.
candidate_calibration_observables: steady mass flow at two prespecified matched outlets
independent local velocity profile on calibration runs
independent_validation: third outlet held out before fitting
complete new fills or experimental sessions
velocity fluctuations, transient mass history and reconciled event types not used in objective
calibration_plan.objective: Prespecified residual vector of matched rate and velocity, weighted by experimental covariance plus independently bounded numerical error. Analyze model-form discrepancy separately. Do not fit all parameters to one discharge curve.
calibration_plan.uncertainty: Propagate independently measured mass/size/geometry/friction intervals and repeat variation; preserve correlated errors; report non-identifiability rather than fabricate precise parameter confidence bounds.
calibration_plan.holdout: Only a future external cohort may be assigned before fitting. Never reuse M3/M4B validation/locked-test runs for fitting or selection.

future_m6b_budget_proposal.stage_a: At most 12 author/provider-curated no-fixed-particle MAT flow files, 3 outlet groups, total <=200MB, with README/checksums/units; no solver attempts. Do not download 17.41GB release. If archive-only access persists, obtain an authorized small subset first.
future_m6b_budget_proposal.stage_b_gate: Separate approval after schema, boundary, particle mixture, geometry and material characterization review. Existing monodisperse wedge is not a match for the tridisperse flat-floor experiment.
future_m6b_budget_proposal.conditional_allocation: 3 paired numerical sensitivity attempts, then at most 9 larger-fill sustained-flow runs (3 fixed outlet ratios x 3 independent fills) at fixed inclination. Stop at the profiling/resource gate if supported windows cannot be generated.
future_m6b_budget_proposal.internal_scaling_option: D/d=6,8,10 at fixed 35deg from vertical, sufficient validated fill for >=200 crossings over >=1s before depletion. This would test internal scaling only until externally matched; no universal-exponent or calibration claim.
future_m6b_budget_proposal.wall_budget: At most 1800 wall seconds per attempt, one CPU worker, at most 6 worker-hours. Runtime is unmeasured for larger fills; profile first, charge failures, no automatic retries.
